items.name: Abyssal Edge
items.desc: A deep-sea forged blade dripping with ocean's might.

items.name: Chaosweaver
items.desc: A blade twisted by chaos, ever-changing and unpredictable.

items.name: Chill Strike
items.desc: A fish-adorned weapon that strikes with lazy precision.

items.name: Cosmic Coil
items.desc: A fluid blade that shifts like cosmic serpents, bearing otherworldly knowledge.

items.name: Dawn's Justice
items.desc: A radiant sword that glows with morning light.

items.name: Drakespine Blade
items.desc: A bone-white sword pulsing with draconic energy.

items.name: Duststrike
items.desc: A sand-worn blade that controls the very winds themselves.

items.name: Earthshaper
items.desc: A blade that commands the very ground beneath.

items.name: Frostheart Claymore
items.desc: A crystalline longsword shimmering with icy blue glow.

items.name: Ghostweave Sword
items.desc: A partially ethereal blade that phases through armor.

items.name: Gilded Dominion
items.desc: A gold-plated sword encrusted with corrupted jewels.

items.name: Glutton's Scepter
items.desc: An impossibly large drumstick weapon, forever fresh and slightly bloodied. The ultimate trophy of goblin greed.

items.name: Green Death
items.desc: A ghostly green blade that remembers its commander's eternal war.

items.name: Horn Dancer
items.desc: A graceful katana-style blade adorned with flowing crimson silk, pulsing with Horn Havoc's chaotic essence.

items.name: Howling Edge
items.desc: A moon-blessed blade with fang-like edges, carrying echoes of its master's eternal howl.

items.name: Infernal Brand
items.desc: An eternally burning blade of pure flame.

items.name: Infernal Fork
items.desc: A burning dual-pronged weapon that tears like hellfire claws.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.desc: Standart Blade. Cool. Cool cool cool.

items.name: Mindbreaker
items.desc: A dark purple blade that whispers ancient secrets.

items.name: Mindshatter
items.desc: A sword crackling with raw psychic energy.

items.name: Moonweaver
items.desc: A sword that captures and wields moonlight.

items.name: Mountainheart
items.desc: An immovable blade of pure stone and earth.

items.name: Nightfang
items.desc: A blade forged from condensed shadows.

items.name: Plaguebringer
items.desc: A corrupted blade seeping with toxins.

items.name: Serpent's Kiss
items.desc: A curved blade with scales that ripple in moonlight.

items.name: Shackled Magma
items.desc: A sword of restrained magma, burning eternally against its stone bonds.

items.name: Soulharvest Scythe
items.desc: A grim, curved scythe that emanates a cold, deathly aura.

items.name: Starcutter
items.desc: Crystalline blade of fused starlight, casting prismatic reflections in blue, green, and pink like cosmic stained glass.

items.name: The All-Seeing Blade
items.desc: A pink, fleshy sword with a pulsating, organic core.

items.name: The Devourer
items.desc: Living weapon with a ravenous emerald maw, forever seeking its next feast.

items.name: The Last Laugh
items.desc: A purple blade with an enigmatic blue core, carrying echoes of its master's chilling smile.

items.name: The Watcher's Gaze
items.desc: A blade that is starving forever.

items.name: Tidecaller
items.desc: A rugged blade wrapped in cloth, radiating warrior's resilience.

items.name: Tidewoven Blade
items.desc: A sword forged from crystallized ocean currents.

items.name: Liora's Necklace
items.desc: A testament to Pyren's concealed vow.

items.name: Broom
items.desc: A librarian's tool from before the Rupture, enchanted to carry books without strain. It never learned to fly—just to hover, endlessly patient.

items.name: Lantern
items.desc: Pact patrol equipment. Their beacon network once connected every settlement.

charms.name: Clover
charms.desc: Grows in all kinds of forests

goods.name: Beast Vial
goods.desc: Drink to resets your monster hunting talents.

goods.name: Blood Potion
goods.desc: Increases your berserk damage by 50%. A survival tonic brewed during desperate times. The hermit witch crafted it when isolation meant facing dangers alone—turning desperation into defiance.

goods.name: Large Rage Potion
goods.desc: Increases Attack by 50% and reduces speed by 50%

goods.name: Medium Rage Potion
goods.desc: Increases Attack by 40% and reduces speed by 60%

goods.name: Rage Potion
goods.desc: Increases Attack by 30% and reduces speed by 70%

goods.name: Cheese
goods.desc: How much cheese is too much cheese?

goods.name: Jam
goods.desc: Do you want ants? Because that's how you get ants!

goods.name: Potato
goods.desc: Cook it to eat. Requires dirt in a warm climate

goods.name: Super Berry
goods.desc: Eat it to gain a permanent stat boost for your defensive stats.

goods.name: Super Shroom
goods.desc: Eat it to gain a permanent stat boost for your offensive stats.

goods.name: Bat Wing
goods.desc: Makes a great fan for those sunny days

goods.name: Chain
goods.desc: Mass-produced in Pact foundries for their signature armor. Standardization was their strength.

goods.name: Resonance Powder
goods.desc: Used to upgrade a obol resonance row.

goods.name: Eyeball
goods.desc: Stare at it long enough, and it might wink back!

goods.name: Monster Key
goods.desc: So far, no one knows what it is used for.

goods.name: Chalice of Abundance
goods.desc: Merchant-warriors who valued aggression over longevity. Their raids were legendary. Their retirements were theoretical.

goods.name: Colossus Heart
goods.desc: The Patient Giants: health measured in ages, speed in geological time. They'll outlive everything. Slowly.

goods.name: Courier's Testament
goods.desc: Messengers who prioritized delivery over survival. Messages always arrived on time. Messengers arrived in pieces. Acceptable trade-off.

goods.name: Executioner's Verdict
goods.desc: Carved for those who valued impact over haste. They won every battle. Eventually. Long after it mattered.

goods.name: Fools Fortune
goods.desc: Battlefield scavengers who armored themselves against opportunistic violence. Found everything eventually. Very, very eventually.

goods.name: Huntsman's Mark
goods.desc: Swift hunters who tracked for days, struck for seconds. Their kills were elegant. Rarely fatal.

goods.name: Inferno's Wrath
goods.desc: Carved by those who saw defense as cowardice. Their convictions were absolute. Their funerals were frequent.

goods.name: Lamp of Seeking
goods.desc: The Archive Keepers believed understanding was salvation. Vast reserves of life, minimal violence. They studied threats instead of fighting them. Worked surprisingly often.

goods.name: Warden's Oath
goods.desc: The Endurance Doctrine: outlast all threats through sheer stubborn existence. Succeeded. Nobody noticed.

goods.name: Tower Revert Rune
goods.desc: Useful in the tower. Curiously, these runes seem drawn to dark, watery depths...

goods.name: Fish Fossil
goods.desc: The exact age is unknown. It seems to be found in all ores.

goods.name: Flora Fossil
goods.desc: The exact age is unknown. It seems to be found in all ores.

goods.name: Fossil
goods.desc: The exact age is unknown. It seems to be found in all ores.

places.name: Sunny Field
places.desc: A peaceful meadow where adventures begin. The perfect place for taking your first steps.

places.name: Whisper Cave
places.desc: The wind creates eerie melodies as it passes through the entrance. Every step echoes with possibility.

places.name: Jungle of the Lost
places.desc: Nature reclaims everything here. Even your footprints vanish quickly behind you.

places.name: Cursed Vale
places.desc: An ancient forest bathed in otherworldly violet light. The massive trees pulse with dark energy.

places.name: Crystal Depths
places.desc: Massive crystals illuminate vast chambers in otherworldly colors. Their surfaces reflect more than just light.

places.name: Sun's Basin
places.desc: A vast crater where legend says the sun once fell. The glassed sand still radiates ancient heat.

places.name: Frost Grove
places.desc: An eternal winter grips these woods. The trees crack under the weight of never-ending ice.

places.name: The Well
places.desc: A massive pit filled with ancient water. Most of its depths remain unexplored, and perhaps should stay that way.

places.name: Highland Sanctuary
places.desc: Precarious settlements cling to jagged cliffs, where magical ores pulse with energy.

places.name: Square Isle
places.desc: An isolated isle where trees grow in unnatural squares. The ocean views clash with the geometric forest.

places.name: Sharp Peaks
places.desc: A notoriously dangerous mountain range where even the air cuts like knives.

places.name: Red Forest
places.desc: Trees stained crimson by events long past. The color isn't quite natural, nor is the silence.

places.name: Mycropolis
places.desc: A city built of massive mushrooms, grown wild and free in ancient woods.

places.name: Sulfur Marsh
places.desc: Everything here has a jaundiced tint. Even the water seems infected with something ancient.

places.name: Ancient Capital
places.desc: Ruins from before the Brothers' War. The oldest known civilization's last remnants.

bosses.name: The Final Chef
bosses.desc: A reaper who collects souls like ingredients for his cosmic soup

bosses.name: Mr Pupil
bosses.desc: A colossal bloodshot eye adorned with squirming mouth-like appendages. It sees. It hungers. It waits.

bosses.name: Sharpfin
bosses.desc: A shark-like warrior wielding an orange blade of ancient origins

bosses.name: Ice Cube Slime
bosses.desc: Nature's attempt at geometric perfection gone horribly right

bosses.name: Galactic Tear
bosses.desc: An impossible tear in space, its edges crackling with powers that should never touch our realm. The universe itself tries to look away.

bosses.name: Predator Prime
bosses.desc: A green, reptilian beast with predator eyes

bosses.name: Sandstorm Seeker
bosses.desc: A pale, many-eyed being that loves to swim through desert winds

bosses.name: Triple Trouble
bosses.desc: A three-headed skeletal horror wielding a massive dark blade

bosses.name: Squiggles
bosses.desc: A horror from beyond that just wants a hug (and your soul)

bosses.name: King Nothing
bosses.desc: An eternally lounging sovereign of excess, crowned in broken gold and surrounded by the phantoms of long-lost luxury.

bosses.name: Toxic Drake
bosses.desc: A skeletal dragon seeping with venomous energy

bosses.name: Deep Blue Director
bosses.desc: A militant creature of the deep, its broad-shouldered silhouette crowned with razor hands. The abyss's own general

bosses.name: Brain Storm
bosses.desc: A pulsating mass of neural tissue that grew legs and attitude

bosses.name: Matchstick Mike
bosses.desc: A living flame that takes 'playing with fire' too literally

bosses.name: Horn Havoc
bosses.desc: A demonic beast with massive orange horns and deadly claws

bosses.name: Spiral Sam
bosses.desc: A snail who spent too much time staring at hypnotic patterns.

bosses.name: Muscle Sprout
bosses.desc: A masked warrior of vegetation with impossibly strong arms

bosses.name: Phantom Knight
bosses.desc: A spectral being wielding both ethereal power and solid steel

bosses.name: Fragment of Madness
bosses.desc: A floating crescent of white teeth, its terrible smile promising delicious madness

bosses.name: Goblin King
bosses.desc: The final form of greed and mischief

bosses.name: Twilight Terror
bosses.desc: A bat-like being with flowing crimson hair

bosses.name: Stone Sentinel
bosses.desc: Ancient rock given stubborn purpose

bosses.name: Radiant Huntress
bosses.desc: Grace's chosen huntress, as merciless as the dawn she commands.

bosses.name: Moon Moon
bosses.desc: A wolf that howled at the moon until it howled back

bosses.name: Hell's Warden
bosses.desc: An evolved form of the Hell's Guardian, forged in deeper flames. Where its lesser kin merely guard, this one commands.

bosses.name: Mind's End
bosses.desc: A cosmic horror from the deepest dreams, where madness meets divinity.

bosses.name: Lazy Dweller
bosses.desc: The chillest of all world bosses, but don't underestimate him in battle

bosses.name: Necro Rat
bosses.desc: The absolute rattiest rat to have ever ratted

bosses.name: Bills Cousin
bosses.desc: A purple pyramid with cosmic awareness

bosses.name: Bound Blaze
bosses.desc: A humanoid flame in ethereal chains

bosses.name: Nightmare Soldier
bosses.desc: A massive Soldier guaranteed to give you nightmares

bosses.name: Rune Wolf
bosses.desc: A werewolf marked by crimson sigils of power

bosses.name: Hungry Eye
bosses.desc: A single eye and mass of mouths always seeking more

monsters.name: Green Slime
monsters.desc: They are hard to spot in the grass. Make sure not to step on them. Otherwise they should't pose a problem.

monsters.name: Pink Slime
monsters.desc: More dangerous than the green ones. It's unknown why they are pink.

monsters.name: Colossal Bloom
monsters.desc: A giant flower that has grown out of control.

monsters.name: Tree Trunker
monsters.desc: They're slow but surprisingly strong, crushing anything in their path.

monsters.name: Spawn Camper
monsters.desc: This guy never left the Sunny Fields, he camps there. The Sun has shrunk him down and turned him yellow.

monsters.name: Soil Serpent
monsters.desc: Slithers just beneath the soil surface, striking when adventurers least expect it.

monsters.name: Bat
monsters.desc: A one-eyed flying terror that hunts by sight alone.

monsters.name: Baby Cyclops
monsters.desc: Don't be fooled by its size - even a young cyclops can crush bones effortlessly.

monsters.name: Tummy
monsters.desc: A bizarre creature that's essentially a walking stomach.

monsters.name: Snake
monsters.desc: Sometimes ties itself into knots trying to follow multiple prey at once.

monsters.name: Undead
monsters.desc: Scorched bones that still wander around. Their skin burned away long ago.

monsters.name: Goblin Warrior
monsters.desc: Hoards anything shiny. Your sword is definitely on their wishlist.

monsters.name: Jungle Spider
monsters.desc: These massive arachnids build webs between the jungle canopy that can trap even the largest prey.

monsters.name: Goblin Mage
monsters.desc: Waves a staff wildly while mumbling nonsense. Somehow, the spells actually work.

monsters.name: Undead Guardian
monsters.desc: Once guards of the nomad settlement in Sun's Basin.

monsters.name: Undead Hulk
monsters.desc: Terrible at golf, but terrific at crushing skulls.

monsters.name: Ice Fly
monsters.desc: Despite their delicate appearance, their frost-covered wings can slice through armor.

monsters.name: Peaks Dweller
monsters.desc: Oddly resembles the Undead Hulk - minus several hundred years of decay.

monsters.name: Winged Undead
monsters.desc: Undead that's really into the 'grim reaper' aesthetic.

monsters.name: Undead Shaman
monsters.desc: Since his skull is empty, it's unknown how he's able to cast spells.

monsters.name: Angry Tree
monsters.desc: He does not like you.

monsters.name: Half Dead
monsters.desc: They are not dead, but they are not alive either.

monsters.name: Dracula
monsters.desc: He's been playing this game for a while now so be prepared to for a challenge.

monsters.name: Forest Horror
monsters.desc: Not a single creature in the forest is safe from this beast.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.desc: They will leave you alone, as long as you don't get in their way.

monsters.name: Glutton Button
monsters.desc: Why doesn't this, the largest monster, simply eat the others?

encounters.name: Abandoned Caravan
encounters.desc: The remains of a nomadic caravan, their belongings scattered but organized as if they planned to return.

encounters.name: Bone Circle
encounters.desc: Bones arranged in reverent patterns around a central depression, as if something was worshipped here.

encounters.name: Chef's Last Stand
encounters.desc: Cooking implements scattered around ingredients that seemed to be fighting each other when the chef fled.

encounters.name: Collapsed Mine
encounters.desc: A cave-in has revealed the entrance to old mining tunnels, with equipment still visible in the rubble.

encounters.name: Cookie Trail
encounters.desc: Stale cookies arranged in a precise pattern leading away from a dangerous cliff edge.

encounters.name: Elemental Crossroads
encounters.desc: A spot where all four elements seem to meet - scorched earth, frozen patches, floating debris, and pooled water.

encounters.name: Emergency Cache
encounters.desc: A hastily buried chest with a merchant's seal, likely hidden during some desperate flight from danger.

encounters.name: Eternal Winter
encounters.desc: A patch of snow and ice that refuses to melt, even in the warmest weather, with festive remnants nearby.

encounters.name: Feeding Station
encounters.desc: Deliberately placed berries and mushrooms, suggesting someone was studying monster dietary habits.

encounters.name: Field Laboratory
encounters.desc: Scattered equipment and partially completed experiments, with strange stains marking failed attempts.

encounters.name: Frozen Flame
encounters.desc: An impossible sight - fire that burns ice-cold, casting blue shadows that somehow feel warm.

encounters.name: Geometric Garden
encounters.desc: Plants grow in perfect geometric patterns here, defying natural growth and seasonal cycles.

encounters.name: Glowing Ore Vein
encounters.desc: A streak of unusual ore runs through exposed rock, pulsing with an otherworldly light.

encounters.name: Goblin Gold Cache
encounters.desc: A hastily hidden stash of shiny objects, clearly gathered by creatures with more greed than sense.

encounters.name: Guard Checkpoint
encounters.desc: Weapons and armor arranged defensively around what was once a checkpoint, now long abandoned.

encounters.name: Investment Portfolio
encounters.desc: Carefully organized collection of shiny objects, bottle caps, and interesting buttons - clearly a diversified portfolio.

encounters.name: Love's Remnant
encounters.desc: Scattered rose petals and heart-shaped stones mark what might have been a romantic gesture gone wrong.

encounters.name: Luck Shrine
encounters.desc: Stones arranged around lucky charms and totems, clearly meant to bring good fortune to travelers.

encounters.name: Meditation Circle
encounters.desc: Stones arranged for contemplation, with notes about learning from monster behavior scattered about.

encounters.name: Miner's Lunch
encounters.desc: A lunch tin sits open next to mining tools, the meal half-finished as if interrupted by something urgent.

encounters.name: Mobile Workshop
encounters.desc: Ingenious portable crafting setup designed for life on the move, with weather-resistant storage.

encounters.name: Mushroom Network
encounters.desc: A fairy ring of mushrooms that seem to pulse in unison, as if connected by some invisible network.

encounters.name: Questionable Feast
encounters.desc: A table set for dinner with partially eaten meals, as if the diners suddenly remembered urgent appointments elsewhere.

encounters.name: Scholar's Refuge
encounters.desc: Hidden study where someone tried to preserve knowledge from before the great catastrophe.

encounters.name: Slime Pool
encounters.desc: The ground here is unnaturally fertile, with strange acidic patches and dissolved organic matter.

encounters.name: Smithy Ruins
encounters.desc: Tools and materials left mid-project, as if the artisan was called away suddenly and never returned.

encounters.name: Tower Fragment
encounters.desc: A piece of strange, impossibly tall architecture jutting from the ground, its surface still warm to the touch.

encounters.name: Warrior's Practice Ring
encounters.desc: Scarred training ground with broken weapons and detailed notes about monster movement patterns.

encounters.name: Weather Station
encounters.desc: Sophisticated setup for monitoring weather patterns, with tiny umbrellas and detailed atmospheric readings.

encounters.name: Weeping Stone
encounters.desc: A boulder that constantly drips clear water, despite no visible source, with flowers growing at its base.

talents.name: Fire Resistance

talents.desc: Increases your Health by 0.02% per level for every 100 coliseum trophies you have.

talents.name: Water Resistance
